Every .qnt under packages/ must appear in `files`, as `modules`, `typecheckOnly` (with the reason) or `delegated`.
hold: init/step must keep `invariants` and reach every `witnesses` entry. violate: the pre-fix variant (init or step)
must break exactly the invariant its bug broke; `residual: true` marks a known-open violation that a fix must flip.
tier defaults to pr (verify is always nightly). Samples are per check; the nightly tier multiplies hold samples.
When a model lands, add its entry here in the same change; a fix ships a violate check for its pre-fix variant.
